vicreg.features: student encoder output before teacher temporal standardization; no projector
vicreg.selection: complete, audible tokens of a separate unmasked student forward
vicreg.covariance: globally centered, unbiased weighted batch/time covariance; equal records within domains

protocol.objective: paired GPT-2 initialization: latent only, then latent + variance + .04 covariance; fresh identical initial weights for both
protocol.readout: FP32 frozen encoder, train-only standardized ridge; validation-only alpha/threshold
protocol.pitch: 128 MIDI key-active frame labels at 50 ms centers; no pedal extension
protocol.micro_ap: flattened key/frame scores; exact ties grouped; same F1-selected readout
protocol.checkpoint: fixed final 10000 updates; no test selection
protocol.validation_diagnostics: 6 fixed recordings, fixed crop/mask, every 500 steps incl step 0
protocol.gpt2_scope: only attention output and FFN down weight normal initialization, std .02/sqrt(2*layers)
protocol.regularizer_view: separate unmasked student encoder forward, no projector
protocol.teacher: EMA .99 to .999 over first 1000 updates; same encoder unmasked; per-record temporal standardization, std floor .1
protocol.limits: one seed; only three held-out music works; repeatedly used exploratory test; no claim of general superiority
